name: terrain-v3-candidate

attitude_gate.terrain_relative: local roll/pitch error and world yaw <= 5 deg

success_gate: completed plus both wheel terrain contacts; mixed also requires configured obstacle contacts; velocity/stop gates unchanged
selection: total failures, legacy failures, mixed failures, then relative/world yaw score; midpoint and endpoint
final_holdout: open once only after stopping; never select or continue training from it
animation: 1024 overview and selectable live detail must be visible during formal training
